recognize_zh: LMO2 免疫染色（高倍）：部分腫瘤細胞呈強弱不一的核陽性，許多細胞為陰性或弱陽性，而右側血管內皮細胞呈強核陽性可作為內部陽性對照；LMO2 是生發中心標記，帶有 t(14;18) 的濾泡性淋巴瘤常失去 LMO2 表現。
features: Heterogeneous nuclear LMO2 staining in a subset of neoplastic follicular cells
Many tumor nuclei weakly positive or negative
Strong nuclear LMO2 in endothelial cells along the right edge (internal positive control)
Monotonous medium to large cells with round to slightly irregular nuclei
describe_en: Immunohistochemical stain for LMO2 at high power shows heterogeneous nuclear staining, with a subset of neoplastic follicular cells moderately to strongly positive and many others weakly positive or negative. Endothelial cells along the right side show strong nuclear staining and serve as an internal positive control. LMO2 is a germinal-center marker that is expressed in reactive germinal centers and in most follicular lymphomas lacking BCL2 rearrangement, whereas t(14;18)-positive follicular lymphomas frequently show loss of LMO2. The partial expression here should be interpreted together with BCL2 immunostaining and FISH in this grade 3a follicular lymphoma.

ddx.vs: Reactive germinal centers show uniform strong LMO2 nuclear staining with BCL2-negative germinal-center cells.
Burkitt lymphoma is characteristically LMO2 negative (MYC-related loss) with a Ki67 near 100% and diffuse starry-sky pattern.
Marginal zone lymphoma cells are LMO2 negative, with positivity limited to residual colonized germinal centers.
